title_en: Professor Cho Hak-soo of Hoseo University is the new information security PM.
summary_en: [GD Net Korea] Professor Cho Hak-soo of Hoseo University, who has extensive corporate experience, was appointed as the new program manager (PM) in the information security field at the Institute for Information and Communications Technology Planning and Evaluation (IITP). Previously, IITP posted an information protection PM notice on its website on May 12 and began the selection process. The first document screening was conducted in the third week of June, and the second interview was conducted in the first week of July. New information security PM Cho will attend the '2026 Information Security Industry R&D Meeting' held at the Korea Information Security Association (KISIA) in Garak-dong, Seoul at 2 p.m. on the 7th and meet with businesspeople for the first time. Security PM Cho graduated from the Department of Computation and Statistics at Seoul National University and received a master's degree from the same university. He is a security expert who completed his doctorate at Korea University. Worked at several security companies. In the past, he served as Vice President and Chief Technology Officer (CTO) of Wynns, where he led the listing on KOSDAQ and the development of overseas markets. By exporting security solutions to Japan's NTT Docomo, it also contributed to achieving the '10 Million Dollar Export Tower', the first in the information security industry. While serving as director of the Wynns Research Institute, he also served as a member of the Science and Technology Committee of the Fourth Industrial Revolution Committee. In addition, he also worked at Afreeca TV and ML Soft, and was hired as Vice President of Labrador Labs in February of this year. title_en: 5G core investment, overtaking LTE for the first time... Impact of SA spread
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] The investment scale of the 5G mobile core network recorded the same market size as the LTE core network for the first time, attracting attention as analysis showed that the axis of investment has completely shifted. In particular, 5G mobile core network investment volume accounted for 50% of the entire mobile core network market for the first time. Dell Oro commented on this phenomenon. Dave Bolen, research director at Dell'Oro Group, said, "2025 is the year when 5G SA networks reach an inflection point and begin to spread into the market. summary_ja: [ジディネットコリア]自律走行車の拡散を主導してきたウーバーがロボタクシー規制をめぐって労働組合と意外な連帯に乗り出した。運転者雇用保護を主張する労組と人間運転者・自律走行車が共に運営されるプラットフォームを守ろうとするウーバーの利害関係がウェイモ牽制という点で合致した結果だ。ウーバーが米国主要都市のロボタクシー規制論争で労働組合のような声を出している。過去の車両呼出運転者の労働者の地位と福祉問題をめぐって労働界と衝突したのとは対照的な行より。 1日（現地時間）CNBCによると、ワシントンDC議会は乗客と貨物輸送に自律走行車を広範囲に投入できるようにする「自律走行車配置承認改正法」を審議している。労働界はロボタクシーが運転者の賃金と雇用を脅かすと法案。ワシントンDCでは、約3万5000人がプラットフォーム運転手として働くと推定される。連邦政府の減源などで地域雇用が急減した状況で、ロボタクシー導入が雇用不安を高める可能性があるという主張だ。ウーバーも自律走行車の全面的な拡散ではなく、人間運転者と自律走行車が共に運行する「混合型ネットワーク」を維持しなければならないという立場を出した。
title_en: Uber and labor union join hands to keep robotaxi in check... The common enemy is Waymo
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] Uber, which has led the spread of self-driving cars, has entered into an unexpected solidarity with labor unions over robotaxi regulations. This is the result of the union's interest in protecting driver jobs and Uber's interests in protecting a platform where human drivers and self-driving cars operate together at the point of keeping Waymo in check. Uber is speaking with the labor union in the debate over robotaxi regulations in major U.S. cities. This is a move that stands in contrast to the past clashes with the labor community over the employee status and welfare issues of ride-hailing drivers. According to CNBC on the 1st (local time), the Washington D.C. Congress is deliberating the ‘Autonomous Vehicle Deployment Approval Amendment Act’, which will allow for the widespread use of self-driving cars for passenger and cargo transportation. Labor groups are opposing the bill, saying that robotaxi could threaten drivers’ wages and jobs. It is estimated that about 35,000 people work as platform drivers in Washington, DC. It is argued that the introduction of robotaxi could increase job insecurity at a time when local jobs have plummeted due to federal government layoffs. Uber also took the position that rather than the full-scale expansion of self-driving cars, it should maintain a ‘mixed network’ where human drivers and self-driving cars operate together. title_en: Amazon completes investment of 72 trillion won in Open AI... Secure 5% stake
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] Amazon invested a total of $50 billion (approximately KRW 72.3 trillion) in Open AI, which is expected to be listed next year, and secured approximately 5% of the stake. According to foreign media such as the Financial Times on the 1st (local time), Amazon invested $15 billion in Open AI in February. Amazon decided to invest an additional $35 billion (approximately KRW 50.61 trillion) if certain conditions, such as an initial public offering (IPO) or groundbreaking performance in the AI ​​field, were met. However, Amazon completed a full investment of a total of $50 billion even though these conditions were not met. According to the performance report released by the company on the 1st, with this investment, OpenAI, which has been running a deficit, has secured a large amount of new funding. This investment is evaluated as having strengthened the relationship between the two companies by adding a large-scale equity investment to existing business cooperation in semiconductors, computing resources, and cloud services. In addition, OpenAI has secured the funds necessary to learn the next-generation AI model, which costs a huge amount of money. An official familiar with the matter said that OpenAI received its last investment this week, which brought Amazon's stake to about 5%. The background to Amazon executing all of the remaining investment was Open A... last April.

title_en: A research report states that whether a personal FPS will be a hit for a long time can be predicted by the number of streamers/video contributors "as of the third day of release." However, it's not just that ``it's good enough to be seen a lot.''
summary_en: According to Gamesight, when it comes to predicting the long-term success of PvP FPS games, the ``number of players'' rather than the amount of time content is played by streamers or video contributors can be a more effective indicator.

summary_ko: Gamesight에 의하면, PvP FPS 게임의 장기적인 성공 예측에는, 배포자나 동영상 투고자에 의한 컨텐츠의 재생 시간이 아니라, 오히려 “인원수”가 유효한 지표가 될 수 있다고 한다.
